# AirSource X Design Context

## Project

- Product type: Judge-facing retrospective air-quality research demo
- Stack: Static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Color mode: Dark
- Density: Spacious editorial with compact chart labels

## Visual Direction

The user selected an adaptation of the supplied Ascend interface reference: deep navy atmosphere, restrained mint signal color, layered dark evidence panels, and orbital geometry. The distinctive AirSource X content remains centered on actual held-out Delhi experiment results and their limitations.

## Tokens

- Background `#050912`; raised surface `#0A1120`; panel `#0B1423`
- Foreground `#F1F5F9`; secondary copy `#A5B3C6`
- Mint `#6AF0B7`; blue `#8AB6FF`; uncertainty amber `#F1B976`
- Display/body: Inter; labels: DM Mono
- Control radius `7px`; panel radius `12px`; feature panel radius `17px`

## Constraints

- Use actual Delhi experiment values and retain the one-station retrospective scope.
- Keep uncertainty and limitations easy to find.
- Conceptual artwork must not read as a pollution map.
- Preserve keyboard interaction and reduced-motion support.
